en.title: Saffron Winds and Echoes of the Lost Oasis
en.premise: Zaid, a young courier of the desert, discovers a mysterious 'Dawn Radio' amidst the bustle of an antique market—a device capable of capturing voices from another world for only a few fleeting minutes at daybreak. Through the static, he hears the desperate plea of a girl imprisoned in 'Azure,' a legendary village that vanished from all maps centuries ago. To rescue the people of this frozen paradise and uncover its hidden treasures, Zaid sets out toward an unknown horizon.

zh.title: 藏红花之风与失落绿洲的残响
zh.premise: 沙漠中的年轻搬运工扎伊德，在古物市场的喧嚣之中，偶然获得了一台名为“黎明广播”的奇特设备。这台收音机仅在黎明后的短短几分钟内，能捕捉到来自异世界的声音。而他听到的，竟是被囚禁在数百年前便从地图上消失的传说之村——“阿祖尔”中，一名少女悲痛的呼救。为了拯救那个时间静止的村庄及其失落乐园的秘宝，扎伊德决定向未知的地平线启程。
